text_block_list.text:
My three years with Mejiro Ramonu had come to an end.
One day, as I was looking back on that milestone—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —I see... So that is how you entered into a trainer contract with Ms. Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I think I kinda understand
how you feel, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Ramonu's running really grabs
everyone's attention, doesn't it!

Today, I was invited by the pre-debut Umamusume of the Mejiro family,
who wished to retrace Mejiro Ramonu's footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then?
After making your debut... what comes next!

I believe I heard Mejiro Ramonu is returning here today as well.
Perhaps you could speak with her directly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, everyone gets nervous! Especially when they're up against Ramonu-san."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Is it because she's such an incredible person...
that I'm feeling intimidated all on my own?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that so~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the sun right next to Lady Ramonu
is simply delightful~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright doesn't mind the silence, but...
Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"How do you run so amazingly?"
...Not like I can just come right out and ask that, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I took the liberty of inviting Trainer over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My older sister is outside painting right now.
I wouldn't want to disturb her free time, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Above all, Onee-sama is Onee-sama.
Surely you know that already?

It's certainly hard to imagine Mejiro Ramonu taking an interest
and mentoring an underclassman.
Still, perhaps if you tried asking her—
choice_data_list: She might teach you Ramonu's own kind of "language."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In her own way as an older sister, you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...So amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A little while ago, I came here just wanting to know... how I could talk to Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm a little frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've spent
more time with Sister than you have!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Certainly.
What is it?
choice_data_list: I want to show everyone the path you've walked.
I want to show everyone the path you've walked.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To the family course.
Please make sure it has been properly maintained.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Call those girls over next.
Get them ready to run."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My everything
is drawn with horseshoes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Trace it and it will emerge...
After that, do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—If I could retrace even a fraction
of this love..."
